```{r read_data,include=FALSE}
reg_df_subset=fread(paste0(working_path,
                 'w_clean_control.csv'))
```

```{r contractor_capability, include=FALSE}

# Number of projects with positive delay before QuickPay

delay_before_qp=reg_df_subset[post_t==0 & delay>0][,
                         .(num_projs_delayed=n_distinct(contract_award_unique_key)),
                       by='recipient_duns']


num_proj_before_qp=reg_df_subset[post_t==0][,
                         .(num_projs=n_distinct(contract_award_unique_key)),
                       by='recipient_duns']

contractor_capability=merge(delay_before_qp,
                            num_proj_before_qp,
         by='recipient_duns',
         all.y=T)

contractor_capability=contractor_capability[!is.na(recipient_duns)]
# Set na values for num_projs_delayed to be zero 
contractor_capability[is.na(contractor_capability)]=0
contractor_capability[,frac_delayed:=num_projs_delayed/num_projs]
```


```{r merge_with_reg, include=FALSE}
reg_df_subset[, two_digit_psc:=substr(product_or_service_code,1,2)]
reg_df_subset[, two_digit_naics:=substr(naics_code,1,2)]

reg_df_subset=merge(reg_df_subset,
                    contractor_capability[,c('recipient_duns',
                                             'frac_delayed')],
                    by='recipient_duns',
                    all.x=T)
```


```{r matching, include=FALSE}
set.seed(190)

input=na.omit(reg_df_subset,
                            cols=c('product_or_service_code',
                                'awarding_sub_agency_code',
                                'naics_code',
                                'wins_project_quarter_stage',
                                'wins_number_of_offers_received',
                                'winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i',
                                'winsorized_initial_budget_i',
                                'frac_delayed'))

matched_df_1=match.data(matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+
                                  as.factor(awarding_sub_agency_code)+
                                  as.factor(two_digit_naics)+
                                  as.factor(action_date_year_quarter)+
                                  winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i+
                                  winsorized_initial_budget_i+
                                  wins_number_of_offers_received,
                                data=input,
                                cutpoints= list(frac_delayed=5,
                                                winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i = 5,
                                                winsorized_initial_budget_i = 5,
                                                wins_number_of_offers_received=5),
                                method='cem'))

matched_df_2=match.data(matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+
                                  winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i+
                                  winsorized_initial_budget_i+
                                  wins_number_of_offers_received,
                      data=input,
                      exact=~as.factor(awarding_sub_agency_code)+
                                as.factor(two_digit_psc)+
                               as.factor(two_digit_naics)+
                                as.factor(action_date_year_quarter),
                      method='nearest',
                      ratio=1))

matched_df_3=match.data(matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+
                                  winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i+
                                  winsorized_initial_budget_i+
                                  wins_number_of_offers_received,
                      data=input,
                      exact=~as.factor(awarding_sub_agency_code)+
                                as.factor(two_digit_psc)+
                               as.factor(two_digit_naics)+
                                as.factor(action_date_year_quarter),
                      method='nearest',
                      ratio=2))

matched_df_4=match.data(matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+
                                  winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i+
                                  winsorized_initial_budget_i+
                                  wins_number_of_offers_received,
                      data=input,
                      exact=~as.factor(awarding_sub_agency_code)+
                                as.factor(two_digit_psc)+
                               as.factor(two_digit_naics)+
                                as.factor(action_date_year_quarter),
                      method='nearest',
                      ratio=3))

matched_df_5=match.data(matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+
                                  winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i+
                                  winsorized_initial_budget_i+
                                  wins_number_of_offers_received,
                      data=input,
                      exact=~as.factor(awarding_sub_agency_code)+
                                as.factor(two_digit_psc)+
                               as.factor(two_digit_naics)+
                                as.factor(action_date_year_quarter),
                      method='nearest',
                      ratio=4))

matched_df_6=match.data(matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+
                                  winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i+

                                  wins_number_of_offers_received,

                               as.factor(two_digit_naics)+
                                as.factor(action_date_year_quarter),

matched_df_7=match.data(matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+

                                  wins_number_of_offers_received,

matched_df_8=match.data(matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+

matched_df_9=match.data(matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+

```

```{r regs, include=FALSE}
df_list=list(matched_df_1,
             matched_df_2,
             matched_df_3,
             matched_df_4,
             matched_df_5,
             matched_df_6,
             matched_df_7,
             matched_df_8,
             matched_df_9,
             matched_df_10,
             matched_df_11,
             matched_df_12)

reg_list=list()
estimate_percentage_delay=list()
sample_size_percentage_delay=list()

i=1
for(df in df_list){
  print(i)
  setDT(df)
  df[,wins_percentage_delay:=100*Winsorize(percentage_delay,probs=c(0.025,0.975),na.rm=T)]
  df[,winsorized_delay:=Winsorize(delay,probs=c(0.025,0.975),na.rm=T)]
  m=feols(wins_percentage_delay~treat_new+
                            post_t:treat_new+
                            log(wins_project_quarter_stage)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            wins_number_of_offers_received+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            post_t:wins_number_of_offers_received|
                            naics_code+product_or_service_code+action_date_year_quarter,
                          data=df, 
                          weights=~weights,
                          cluster=~contract_award_unique_key)
  
  estimate_percentage_delay[[i]]=setDT(tidy(m, conf.int=T))[term=='treat_new:post_t']
  sample_size_percentage_delay[[i]]=glance(m)$nobs
  reg_list[[i]]=m
  i=i+1
}
```

```{r set_order, include=FALSE}
order=c("coarsened_exact",
        "psm",
        "nn_2",
        "nn_3",
        "nn_4",
        "mahalanobis",
        "lasso",
        "rpart",
        "caliper_02",
        "caliper_03",
        "caliper_04",
        "caliper_05")

models=do.call("rbind",estimate_percentage_delay)

models=setDT(models)
models[,specification:=as.factor(seq(1,12))]
models[,sample_size:=unlist(sample_size_percentage_delay)]

```

```{r plot, include=FALSE}
a=ggplot(models, aes(x=specification,y=estimate)) +         
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, 
                    ymax = conf.high,
                    width=0.1))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(color="black"))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color="maroon")+
  ylab("Estimate \n (Percentage delay)")+
  ylim(-1,5)+
  xlab("")

b=ggplot(models, aes(x=specification,
                     y=sample_size)) +         
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           color="gray",
           width=0.6) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(color="black"))+
  scale_y_continuous(label=comma,limits=c(0,230000))+
  ylab("Sample size")+
  xlab("")

models[,method:= order]

models2=fastDummies::dummy_cols(models[,c('specification','method')],
                                select_columns = "method",
                                remove_selected_columns = TRUE,
                                ignore_na = TRUE,
                                split = "\\+")
models2=models2%>%
  pivot_longer(!specification, names_to = "method", values_to = "binary")

setDT(models2)[,method:=str_replace_all(models2$method, "method_", "")]
models2[,method_name:=case_when(method=="coarsened_exact"~"Coarsened Exact matching",
                                method=="lasso"~"Lasso",
                                method=="rpart"~"Tree-based",
                                method=="mahalanobis"~"Mahalanobis",
                                method=="psm"~"Propensity score",
                                method=="nn_2"~"2-Nearest neighbor",
                                method=="nn_3"~"3-Nearest neighbor",
                                method=="nn_4"~"4-Nearest neighbor",
                                method=="caliper_02"~"Caliper 0.2",
                                method=="caliper_03"~"Caliper 0.3",
                                method=="caliper_04"~"Caliper 0.4",
                                method=="caliper_05"~"Caliper 0.5")]

order_of_methods=c("Coarsened Exact matching",
                   "Propensity score",
                   "2-Nearest neighbor",
                   "3-Nearest neighbor",
                   "4-Nearest neighbor",
                   "Mahalanobis",
                   "Lasso",
                   "Tree-based",
                   "Caliper 0.2",
                   "Caliper 0.3",
                   "Caliper 0.4",
                   "Caliper 0.5")

c=ggplot(models2, aes(x = specification, 
                      y = factor(method_name,
                                 levels = rev(order_of_methods)),
                      fill =ifelse(binary==0, 
                                   NA, 
                                   "black"))) +
  geom_point(shape = 21,
             color="black",
             size=3) +
  scale_fill_discrete(na.value = "transparent") +
  scale_size_area(max_size=2)  +
  ylab("Matching method") +
  xlab("")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(color="black"))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

percentage_delay=plot_grid(a, b,c,
          ncol = 1,
          align = "v",             # to align vertically
          axis = "rbl",            # align axes
          rel_heights = c(2, 2, 2))   # adjust relative heights

```
